content.text: `.mb-2` is the odd one out: it's `0.75rem` where the Bootstrap scale (and `.mt-2`) uses `0.5rem`.

input.command: cd /var/tmp/avb-runs/avb-7Rfayf/project; sed -i '7658s/0.75rem/0.5rem/' site/css/styles.css; npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "passed|failed"

content.text:
The site is back to matching the approved screenshots. Both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass.

The cause was in `site/css/styles.css`. The `.mb-2` utility class was set to `0.75rem`, but it should be `0.5rem`, which is what the rest of the spacing scale and `.mt-2` use. The star-rating rows in the "Special Item" and "Popular Item" cards use that class. Each of those rows was 4px too tall. That pushed the prices and buttons down, made those cards taller, and shifted the footer. I changed it back to `0.5rem`.

STATUS: DONE
